standard_prerequisites.use: Full faithfulness of the colimit comparison (same chapter, lemma-relative-descend-homomorphisms), the induction principle for bootstrap on derived categories of spaces (Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma-induction-principle), the affine-local characterization of relative perfectness (lemma-affine-locally-rel-perfect), and the schemes case (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma-descend-relatively-perfect).

core_obligations: Formulate the descent property P for quasi-compact quasi-separated etale objects and note full faithfulness is known.
Reduce essential surjectivity to elementary distinguished squares and affine cases via the induction principle.
Conclude from the schemes case through affine-local translation.

proof_roadmap.step: Colimit comparison is fully faithful; only essential surjectivity remains.
Induction principle reduces to X_0 and Y_0 affine.
Schemes descent result finishes the proof.

difficulty_reason: In the chapter's relative descent situation (X = X_0 x_{S_0} S over a directed limit S of schemes with X_0 -> S_0 quasi-compact quasi-separated and Y_0 -> X_0 a morphism with Y = Y_0 x_{S_0} S), the category of Y-perfect objects of D(O_X) is the colimit of the categories of Y_i-perfect objects of D(O_{X_i}). The retained proof sets up the condition P on qcqs etale objects U_0 that the colimit of relative perfect derived categories map to the perfect derived category on the limit, notes full faithfulness is already established by the chapter's lemma-relative-descend-homomorphisms, reduces essential surjectivity to elementary distinguished squares, and closes by the induction principle for derived categories of spaces (Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma-induction-principle) to the case where X_0 and Y_0 are both affine, where the result is the schemes case (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma-descend-relatively-perfect) transported through the chapter's lemma-affine-locally-rel-perfect. Retained author proof at lines 12505-12575.
